SERVER_PID=$!

echo "=== GET /books (list should show it) ==="

echo "=== GET /books/:id after finish (should say Finished on) ==="

echo "=== GET /books/:id notes block ==="

echo
echo "=== GET unknown id ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/nf.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3010/books/deadbeef

kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "done"

# Books

A tiny app for tracking what you're reading and what you've finished.

- See what's currently in progress and what's done
- Add a book from a form
- Mark a book as finished with one click
- Open a book to see its title, author, and your notes
- Each book has a stable URL you can share (`/books/<id>`)
- No accounts, no database — books live in `data/books.json`

## Run

```sh
npm start          # http://127.0.0.1:3000
npm run dev        # auto-restart on file changes
npm test           # run vitest
```

Override the port with `PORT=4000 npm start`.

## Layout

```
src/
  db.js      # read/write data/books.json, CRUD on books
  server.js  # http server + routes
  views.js   # HTML templates
  util.js    # html escape, form parsing, date formatting
data/
  books.json # the database
test/
  db.test.js
  server.test.js
```

A book looks like:

```json
{
  "id": "a1b2c3d4",
  "title": "Project Hail Mary",
  "author": "Andy Weir",
  "status": "reading",
  "notes": "On chapter 12.",
  "addedAt": "2025-03-01T20:15:00.000Z",
  "finishedAt": null
}
```

To wipe your library, delete `data/books.json` and the app will start fresh on the next request.

curl -sS http://localhost:3010/ | grep -o 'href="/books/[a-f0-9]\{8\}"' | head -5

echo
echo "=== POST /books/:id/finish ==="
NEW_ID=$(curl -sS http://localhost:3010/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9]{8}' | grep -v 'finish' | head -1 | cut -d'/' -f3)
echo "Book id: $NEW_ID"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID/finish | head -3

echo
echo "=== GET /books/:id after finish (should say Finished on) ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID | grep -oE 'Finished on [^<]+|Currently reading'

echo
echo "=== POST /books/:id/notes ==="
curl -sS -i -X POST -d 'notes=Brilliant+book.' http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID/notes | head -3
echo
echo "=== GET /books/:id notes block ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID | grep -A0 'Brilliant book\.'

echo
echo "=== GET unknown id ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/nf.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3010/books/deadbeef
grep -oE 'Not found|That book' /tmp/nf.html | head -2

kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "done"
